# What does a $175 listing shoot really pay you per hour?

> Free calculator for real estate photographers: what each listing package really earns per hour after drive, shoot, editing and admin time, the fee that hits your hourly target, add-on profit and whether to outsource editing. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
